title: Compose source-ordered age-tracer face amounts into compartment candidates

baseline.source_equation: B1.11 SWAP/solute.f90 AgeTracer task 2: sequential face transfer to compartment storage update

scope.inputs: one already ordered n+1 face-age-amount vector (top boundary then each descending face), old compartment storage, current/previous water content, thickness, and already materialized root/lateral age sink rates
scope.operation: for i=1..n in source traversal order, update each candidate compartment with its adjacent face-amount difference and AgeProd term by calling the exact cell candidate
scope.ordering_limit: does not calculate or re-evaluate internal faces; source AgeTracer computes those from the evolving upper compartment concentration during its sequential sweep
scope.state_owner: None; returns a new allocatable candidate vector only

qualification: 100000 deterministic multi-compartment vectors match a direct B1.11 ordered update bitwise at O0 and O2
dimension, finite-value and positive geometry/time validation reject the entire request before publishing a candidate
test explicitly supplies face amounts; no claim that this composes the dynamic sequential advection-dispersion substep
decision_rule: Keep age-tracer time integration, source-order face evaluation, water-coupled owner state, accepted mass, restart and production admission unqualified.
